scope: Every timestamped direct PNG is hashed against its verified PPU frame index and decoded. Only active same-area adjacent physical frames with actual retained DMA coverage enter transient comparisons. Conservative neighbor sprite masks and outer8pixels remain excluded. Diagnostic image alignment spans0..8pixels to accommodate independently observed skipped-publication catch-up; it is not a relaxed gameplay/camera assertion or a claim that rendered jumps are acceptable. Same-before/after yet different-middle12pixel clusters are candidates requiring human/source investigation. Persistent corruption, longer flashes, sprite/body omissions, missing actors, every item and other graphical or source-fidelity defects are outside this detector. An empty candidate list is not an all-graphics pass. Older asynchronous decoder PNGs are not scanned here.
